value.text:
İstanbul Şişli Vocational School (İstanbul Şişli Meslek Yüksekokulu) is a foundation vocational higher-education institution in Istanbul, Türkiye. Its campus is identified as Şişli, and Turkish is listed as its teaching language. The school was established by İstanbul Şişli Vakfı in 2012. Its establishment was provided for by Council of Ministers Decision 2012/3165, dated 27 April 2012 and published in Official Gazette No. 28296 on 18 May 2012.

Its listed programs span health services, business, technical subjects and creative fields. They include operating-room services, physiotherapy, first and emergency aid, radiotherapy, audiometry, child development and elderly care. Other listed subjects include banking and insurance, foreign trade, alternative energy technology, graphic and fashion design, architectural restoration, tourism and hotel management, and applied English and translation. The institution's reported academic staff count is 60, with no statistical year specified.
